headline: Approved Katie Loesel's Recorded Geology exhibit for the South Burlington Public Art Gallery, running September 17 to November 5.
summary: The committee approved the Recorded Geology exhibit by artist Katie Loesel, which runs September 17 to November 5. Members asked about the title and inspiration of the works and discussed promoting the exhibit at the Energy Festival on September 19th. Installation is planned for September 15 and the opening reception for September 24.
decisions: Approved the Katie Loesel exhibit, Recorded Geology, unanimously.

decision_titles: Katie Loesel exhibit for the South Burlington Public Art Gallery
plain_text:
PAGE 1 
 
 
 
 
 
SOUTH BURLINGTON  
PUBLIC ART COMMITTEE MEETING 
Thursday, September 10, 2026 
 
The South Burlington PUBLIC ART COMMITTEE held a special meeting on Tuesday, 
September 10, 2026, at 12:00 PM at 180 Market Street in Room 310, and by online participation.  
 
Members Present: Sebastian Ryder (Chair), Amanda Holland, Sophia Babbitt, Isaac Cates, 
Karen Liamos, Thomas Lindley, Bryce Myers, Ilona Blanchard (Staff Liaison, non-voting) 
 
Members Not Present: Penne Tomkins, Mark Behr, Michele Bailey (Vermont Art Council, 
non-voting), Tim Barritt (City Council Liaison, non-voting) 
 
Also in Attendance: Maedeh Asgharpur (Gallery Curator) 
 
1. The meeting was convened at 12:02 PM by Sebastian.   
a. This Special Meeting was convened to discuss and approve the proposed Public 
Art Gallery exhibit of work by Katie Loesel for September. The previously 
planned display of works by UVM artists has been postponed at the request of 
UVM, so as not to conflict with a similar on campus exhibit.  
b. All attendees were remote except Ilona, thus no review of emergency procedures 
was necessary. 
c. Karen was identified as the minute taker for the meeting. 
 
2. Opportunity for Public comment on items not on other agenda - no public were present. 
 
3. South Burlington Public Art Gallery  
a. Maedeh reviewed some of the proposal information for on the proposed exhibit 
by artist Katie Loesel entitled Recorded Geology.  The exhibit is planned for 
installation on September 15, 2026 and exhibit will run from September 17th - 
November 5th.  The opening Reception is planned for September 24th. 
b. The Committee had some questions on the title and inspiration and if what is 
stated in the proposal applied across all 3 of the series of works proposed or just 
the initial one mentioned (Plastiglomerate) series. 
c. A suggestion was made to have an explanation of the inspiration for the works 
included in the exhibit. 
d. A discussion also ensued about including something about the exhibit as part of 
the South Burlington Energy Festival on September 19th. Ilona will get 
information to Sophia to see if the exhibit information can be included in the 
promotional information for the event due to the theme of the exhibit.
Public Art Committee Meeting | Page 2 
e. Maedeh will be hanging the exhibit on September 15th. If anyone is available 
before or after our regular meeting on that date, Maeda would welcome setup 
help. 
f. Isaac made a motion to approve the Katie Loesel exhibit, and it was seconded by 
Karen. The motion was approved unanimously.  
 
4. Sebastian mentioned that a discussion about the committee’s potential participation in 
the Energy Festival will be included in the next regular Committee meeting. 
 
5. The meeting was adjourned at 12:32 PM. The next meeting will be at 5:30 PM Tuesday, 
September 15, 2026. 
 
 
 
 
 
Respectfully Submitted, 
 
Karen Liamos
